{{Quote|Dozoisian Snark Venom. Deadly if it passes your lips. Nice try, Hat Lo.|Boba Fett|<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
'''Dozoisian Snark Venom''' was a [[Poison/Legends|venom]]<ref name="Pursuit" /> originating from the [[Dozoisia system/Legends|Dozoisia system]]<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> that was in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It would [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Human/Legends|Human]] once it passed their lips. When mixed with liquids, it would fizz. When the venom would be spilled, an acrid smell and a [[Color/Legends|greenish]] flame could be seen, and a sizzling noise could be heard.<ref name="Pursuit" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]] tried to kill the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] by having his<ref name="Pursuit" /> [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] consort [[Ayy Vida/Legends|Ayy Vida]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|305–306|Vida, Ayy}}</ref> give him a drink which included Dozoisian Snark Venom. However, Fett immediately recognized that and spilled the drink. Lo feigned surprise at Fett's identification of the venom.<ref name="Pursuit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The venom appeared in ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'', a novel written by [[Elizabeth Hand]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="Pursuit" />
